bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user show gace-public-video-collect-resume-20261114.service -p ActiveState --value)" != active
git fetch --no-tags origin ffe7e03c8bea293ad83aa38d4be09b11b4a900aa
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,subprocess,tempfile,os
path=Path("scripts/userbot_public_video_archive.py")
actual=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
if actual!="2e9b2007a367174a7d229f2bf534be055438d3b7ceb7dfecabcfe6369df6c33d":
 raise RuntimeError("ARCHIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED_NOT_OVERWRITING")
content=subprocess.check_output(["git","show","ffe7e03c8bea293ad83aa38d4be09b11b4a900aa:scripts/userbot_public_video_archive.py"])
compile(content.decode(),str(path),"exec")
fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".archive-source-",dir=str(path.parent))
try:
 with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as f:f.write(content)
 os.chmod(tmp,0o644)
 os.replace(tmp,path)
finally:
 if os.path.exists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)
print("ARCHIVE_RETRY_LOGGER=APPLIED")
PY
python3 -m py_compile scripts/userbot_public_video_archive.py
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
if systemctl --user list-units --all --no-legend 'gace-public-video-collect-retry-20261114.service' | grep -q gace-public-video-collect-retry;then echo JOB_ALREADY_STARTED;exit 76;fi
systemd-run --user --collect --unit=gace-public-video-collect-retry-20261114 --property=RuntimeMaxSec=43200 --working-directory="$PWD" /usr/bin/python3 -u scripts/userbot_public_video_archive.py --channel-username theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV --recent-limit 3
echo RETRY_ARCHIVE_START=PASS
systemctl --user show gace-public-video-collect-retry-20261114.service -p ActiveState -p SubState --no-pager
